name: ioctl_pipe
synopsis: int ioctl(int pipefd[1], IOC_WATCH_QUEUE_SET_SIZE, int size);
int ioctl(int pipefd[1], IOC_WATCH_QUEUE_SET_FILTER, struct watch_notification_filter *filter);
description: Provides ioctl operations to configure a notification queue on a pipe. These operations allow setting the queue size and filters for events, which is built on top of a pipe opened with the O_NOTIFICATION_PIPE flag.

parameters.name: pipefd
parameters.description: Array containing the pipe file descriptor

parameters.name: IOC_WATCH_QUEUE_SET_SIZE
parameters.description: Command to set the queue size

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of notification messages to preallocate (1 to 512)

parameters.name: IOC_WATCH_QUEUE_SET_FILTER
parameters.description: Command to set the event filter

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure defining the filter for events

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error and sets errno
